basket_ma50_slope_20d.description: 50DMA slope over 20 trading days, expressed as percent change (e.g., 5 = +5%).

chop_score.description: Choppiness Index (CHOP) value on SPY or basket, 0-100 (e.g., 14-period). Higher implies range-like conditions.

realized_vol_20d_pct.description: 20D realized volatility percentile for SPY (or proxy), 0-100.

vix_pct.description: VIX percentile (or proxy) over a long lookback, 0-100.

hyg_lqd_rs_20d.description: 20D relative strength of HYG vs LQD, expressed as percent change (e.g., 2 = +2%).

spy_tlt_rs_20d.description: 20D relative strength of SPY vs TLT (or IEF), percent change.

breadth_above_50dma_pct.description: Optional breadth proxy: percent of universe above 50DMA, 0-100.

dxy_rs_20d.description: Optional USD strength proxy, 20D percent change (positive = stronger USD).
